subject: Web Development
title: React Native and Mobile JavaScript
description: A 60-second lesson on React Native and Mobile JavaScript.

hook.text: Facebook wanted its mobile apps to feel native but be written in JavaScript.

buildup.text: React Native translates React components into real native platform widgets.

discovery.text: One team could build iOS and Android apps from a single JavaScript codebase.

twist.text: Performance was good but never quite matched fully native apps in demanding scenarios.

climax.text: React Native proved JavaScript could go mobile, even if the debate over quality continues.

punchline.text: JavaScript followed users to their phones.

quiz.question: What does React Native compile JavaScript into?
